title: Smoky Sunday Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting casserole perfect for a Sunday gathering. The combination of smoked sausage and sweet potatoes makes it a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: Cook the smoked sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sweet potatoes, diced tomatoes, olive oil, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the mixture with the cheddar cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
